messages.author: 9600bf9d108950c3
messages.subject: How build a SEM with a exogenous formative latent variable ?
parts:
I'm not sur that my writing with LAVAAN is right.

I have an exogenous formative latent variable (LAT1 with four indicators : X1 to X4) and two reflective latent variables (LAT2 and LAT3 with each four manifests variables Y1 to Y4 and Y5 to Y8).

I wrote 

MODELE1='
LAT1<~X1+X2+X3+X4
LAT2=~Y1+Y2+Y3+Y4
LAT3=~Y5+Y6+Y7+Y8
LAT2~LAT1
LAT3~LAT1
'
but this one seems to be underidentified, and I don't understand why ???

Hervé

messages.subject: Re: How build a SEM with a exogenous formative latent variable ?
parts:

LAT =~ X1+X2+X3+X4

messages.author: 671b14edc9322fa7
messages.subject: Re: How build a SEM with a exogenous formative latent variable ?
parts: Hi

On 15 Sep 2014, at 19:37 , Hervé DE BREST <monco...@gmail.com> wrote:

I'm not sur that my writing with LAVAAN is right.

I have an exogenous formative latent variable (LAT1 with four indicators : X1 to X4) and two reflective latent variables (LAT2 and LAT3 with each four manifests variables Y1 to Y4 and Y5 to Y8).

I wrote 

MODELE1='
LAT1<~X1+X2+X3+X4

You need to provide a scale to LAT1. Try fixing the first formative path to 1

LAT1<~1*X1+X2+X3+X4

Also, you probably want to free the formative error term

LAT1 ~~ LAT1

Mikko

LAT2=~Y1+Y2+Y3+Y4
LAT3=~Y5+Y6+Y7+Y8
LAT2~LAT1
LAT3~LAT1
'
but this one seems to be underidentified, and I don't understand why ???

Hervé
